delivery.title: Iinkcukacha ngokuhanjiswa - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Ukudlula" apha kuthetha kuphela ukuba umncedisi ekujoliswe kuwo ubuyise ubume be HTTP 2xx - ayiqinisekisi inkqubo yokwamkela eneneni egciniweyo okanye eqhutywe phambili. Jonga ibhodi yempendulo engentla ukuba ithini kanye kanye; ukuba akukho nto okanye ukuvuma nje, loo nkqubo ingaba ifumana isicelo kodwa iyala okanye ingawuhoyi umthwalo wokuhlawula ngaphakathi (amagama angalunganga entsimi / ifomathi yayo API , intsimi efunekayo kwicala layo ukuba lo mthwalo wokuhlawula awubandakanyi, njl njl).

push.title: Webhooks eziPhumayo-IiNkokheli zokuTyhala kunye noHlaziyo
push.intro: Ilungiselelwa ngokupheleleyo webhook nganye : JSON , Ifomu (x-www-form-urlencoded), okanye eyakho itemplate yomzimba eSiko kunye <fieldkey></fieldkey> izibambi-ndawo (umzekelo <example></example> ) - isebenza njengokuzalisa umyalelo cURL kanye.
push.curlHelp: Ncamathisela umzekelo isicelo API docs okanye Postman ukunika (nge data yokwenyani okanye isampuli). URL , indlela kunye neeheader zikotshwa njengoko-zinjalo, kwaye zonke izitshixo emzimbeni zidweliswe ngezantsi ukuze ukwazi ukukhetha ukuba yeyiphi intsimi CRM eyizalisa kukhokelo ngalunye.
push.curlPrompt: Unayo cURL yomxhasi? <action>Ngenisa kwi cURL</action> ukuze ugcwalise oku kunye nemimandla yemephu ngokuzenzekelayo.
push.urlVariables: I URL inokuqulatha izinto eziguquguqukayo nazo, umz. <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Okubhalwe ngasentla kwekhasi kufuneka kusebenze JSON , umz {{example}}
push.authTitle: Uqinisekiso (indlela Leadrat engena ngayo kwi API yabo)
push.modeSame: Thumela yonke isiganeko kwi URL efanayo
push.modeCreateUpdate: Yenza irekhodi kube kanye, emva koko uhlaziye irekhodi elifanayo (akukho phinda-phinda kwicala labo)
push.responseIdHint: Apho i- ID ikwi JSON yabo iphendula kwisicelo sokudala. Igcinwe ngokukhokela njenge <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Ukuphela kwexesha, HTTP 429 kunye ne-5xx iimpazamo - emva kwe-1 min, i-5 min, i-30 min, i-2 h, i-6 h.
push.howFilled: Amaxabiso azaliswa njani: le webhook iphinda isetyenziswe kukhokelo ngalunye - Leadrat ayithumeli mzekelo ongatshintshiyo, ithumela utyhala olutsha qho xa isiganeko esikhethiweyo sisenzeka, NALO amaxabiso akhoyo ngoku.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Ifom ibandakanya ngokuzenzekelayo yonke indawo ekhokelayo-akukho nto yokuseta.
push.howFilledCustom: Isiko - bhala eyakho ibhodi yesicelo kwaye uwise naphi na; nganye itshintshiselwa ngexabiso lokwenyani lelo lothe phambi kokuba ithunyelwe. Cofa utshintsho olungezantsi ukuze ulufake.
push.rawTemplate: Body Template (ekrwada) - hlela ngokuthe ngqo okanye ufake izinto eziguquguqukayo
push.preview: Ukujonga kwangaphambili - yintoni eza kuthunyelwa ngokwenene (isampulu yokhokelo)
push.previewEmpty: (bhala itemplate yomzimba ngasentla ukuze ubone imboniso)
push.resyncTruncated_one: Ukuvumelanisa kwakhona kutyhale eyokuqala {{total}} ye {{count}} inkokeli (umda {{limit}} ngomtsi ngamnye). Nciba uluhlu lomhla ukutyhala okuseleyo.
push.resyncTruncated_other: Ukuvumelanisa kwakhona kutyhale eyokuqala {{total}} ye {{count}} izikhokele (umda {{limit}} ngomtsi ngamnye). Nciba uluhlu lomhla ukutyhala okuseleyo.
push.syncHelp: Tyhala lonke ukhokelo olubhalisiweyo kolu luhlu lomhla kwakhona (shiya zombini zingenanto ukutyhala yonke into).

receive.title: Yamkela - Yamkela iiNkokheli kuyo nayiphi na iFomathi
receive.intro: Umthombo ngamnye ufumana URL yawo. Khomba iintengiso ze Facebook ezikhokelayo, Zapier , ifom yewebhusayithi okanye enye webhook ye- CRM kuyo - bathumela izikhokelo kwi JSON yabo okanye ifomati yefomu, kwaye wenze imephu imihlaba yabo kweyakho.
receive.urlIntro: Yamkela URL yakho - nika le kwinkqubo yokuthumela ( POST , JSON okanye ifom-encoded):
receive.newUrlConfirm: Yenza URL entsha ? Eli lidala liyayeka kwangoko ukusebenza.
receive.sendExample: Thumela umzekelo omnye kuqala - uthathwa njengesampulu (akukho nto ithathwa ngaphandle de kugcinwe imephu engezantsi).
receive.securityAuthTitle: Yamkela kuphela izicelo ezisayinwe ngale mfihlelo
receive.sampleLabel: Umzekelo womthwalo (ncamathisela enye, okanye ushiye kungenanto ukuze usebenzise isicelo sokugqibela esifunyenweyo)

pull.title: Tsala-Landa iiNkokheli kuyo nayiphi na API
pull.intro: Leadrat ibiza enye API yenkqubo kwishedyuli (nayiphi na i-auth, nayiphi na i-paging) kwaye ingenisa iirekhodi ezibuyiselayo. Iirekhodi ezibonileyo ngaphambi kokuhlaziya isikhokelo esifanayo.
pull.variables: Izinto eziguquguqukayo: <since></since> (ubaleko lokugqibela oluyimpumelelo, ixesha le-ISO; khupha okokuqala), <others></others>
pull.sampleHelp: Gcina, emva koko Landa isampuli - Leadrat ibiza i API kanye (iphepha lokuqala kuphela) kwaye ayingenisi nto.

api.title: API yakho-UFikelelo lweNdlela ezimbini kuyo nayiphi na inkqubo
api.intro: Nayiphi na inkqubo enesitshixo sakho API inokudala, ifunde kwaye ihlaziye izikhokelo kwaye ibhalisele ukukhokela imicimbi. Thumela isitshixo kwi <hdr></hdr> header, as <bearer></bearer> , okanye (ukuba isixhobo asikwazi ukuseta iiheader) njenge <query></query> . Umda: {{limit}} izicelo ngomzuzu.
api.noPermission: Kuphela umntu onemvume yokuLawula iiSetingi onokujonga isitshixo API .
api.shownOnce: Khuphela eli qhosha ngoku kwaye uligcine kwindawo ekhuselekileyo- ukwenzela ukhuseleko liboniswa kube kanye kuphela. Ukuba ilahlekile, yenza entsha.
api.regenerateConfirm: Yenza isitshixo esitsha API ? Iqhosha langoku liyayeka ukusebenza ngoko nangoko kuyo yonke inkqubo elisebenzisayo.
api.openApiHint: Ngenisa i OpenAPI spec kwi- Postman , Zapier , Yenza okanye n8n ukufumana yonke isiphelo esilungele ukusetyenziswa.
